title: Alfie: An Interactive Robot with a Moral Compass

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a moral score for user-provided actions and contexts (e.g., 'Should I [action] [context]') using sentence similarities in the embedding space of language models like BERT and Universal Sentence Encoder, and collecting interactive human feedback to adjust these moral evaluations.
Evaluating how well the language models' encoded representations align with the moral and deontological values of human culture by extracting normative scores for specific actions.
